Rules.InvariantScript:
ButtonProperties(kind:Text, size:Text, font:Text, text:Text, w:Number, disabled:Boolean,active:Boolean):Text = 
          "data:image/svg+xml;utf8," & EncodeUrl(
              With({
                  FillColor: Switch(kind,
                      "danger",  If(active, AppTheme.ButtonDangerActive, AppTheme.ButtonDangerPrimary),
                      "tertiary", If(active, AppTheme.ButtonTertiaryActive, AppTheme.ButtonTertiary),
                      "ghost",   If(active, AppTheme.ButtonPrimaryActive, "transparent"), 
                      If(active, AppTheme.ButtonPrimaryActive, AppTheme.ButtonPrimary) 
                  ),
                  TextColor: Switch(kind,
                      "ghost",   "#0f62fe", 
                      AppTheme.PrimaryText 
                  ),
                  CalcHeight: Switch(Lower(size),
                      "sm",   32,
                      "md",   40,
                      "lg",   48,
                      "xl",   64,
                      "2xl",  80,
                      48 
                  ),
                  FontSize: Switch(Lower(size),
                      "sm",   "12px",
                      "md",   "14px",
                      "lg",   "14px",
                      "xl",   "16px",
                      "2xl",  "18px",
                      "14px"
                  )
              },
              "<svg width='" & w & "' height='" & CalcHeight & "' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
                  <rect width='100%' height='100%' 
                      fill='" & If(disabled, "#c6c6c6", FillColor) & "' 
                      fill-opacity='" & If(kind = "ghost" && !disabled && !active, "0", "1") & "' />
                  <text 
                      x='16' 
                      y='50%' 
                      dominant-baseline='central' 
                      fill='" & If(disabled, "#8d8d8d", TextColor) & "' 
                      font-family=""" & font & """ 
                      font-size='" & FontSize & "'>
                      " & text & "
                  </text>
              </svg>"
          ));

      TileProperties(kind:Text, title:Text, subtitle:Text, w:Number, h:Number, active:Boolean, disabled:Boolean, font:Text, showArrow:Boolean):Text =
          "data:image/svg+xml;utf8," & EncodeUrl(
              With(
                  {
                      _bg: Switch(kind,
                          "primary", If(disabled, "#525252", If(active, AppTheme.ButtonDisabled, AppTheme.TileBg)),
                          "ghost", "transparent",
                          If(disabled, "#e0e0e0", If(active, "#e0e0e0", "#ffffff"))
                      ),
                      _border: Switch(kind,
                          "primary", If(disabled, "#525252", If(active, "#002d9c", "#0f62fe")),
                          "ghost", If(active, "#0f62fe", "#525252"),
                          If(active, "#0f62fe", "#3d3d3d")
                      ),
                      _titleCol: If(disabled, "#525252", AppTheme.TileText),
                      _subCol: If(disabled, "#393939", If(kind = "primary", "#6f6f6f", "#8d8d8d")),
                      _arrowCol: If(disabled, "#525252", "#8d8d8d"),
                      _font: If(IsBlank(font), "'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif", font),
                      _ty: Text(h / 2 - 9, "[$-en-US]0"),
                      _sy: Text(h / 2 + 10, "[$-en-US]0"),
                      _ax1: Text(w - 28, "[$-en-US]0"),
                      _ax2: Text(w - 16, "[$-en-US]0"),
                      _ay0: Text(h / 2 - 6, "[$-en-US]0"),
                      _aym: Text(h / 2, "[$-en-US]0"),
                      _ay1: Text(h / 2 + 6, "[$-en-US]0")
                  },
                  "<svg width='" & w & "' height='" & h & "' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>" &
                  "<rect width='" & w & "' height='" & h & "' fill='" & _bg & "' stroke='" & _border & "' stroke-width='0'/>" &
                  "<text x='16' y='" & _ty & "' dominant-baseline='central' fill='" & _titleCol & "' font-family=""" & _font & """ font-size='14px' font-weight='600'>" & title & "</text>" &
                  "<text x='16' y='" & _sy & "' dominant-baseline='central' fill='" & _subCol & "' font-family=""" & _font & """ font-size='11px'>" & subtitle & "</text>" &
                  If(showArrow && !disabled,
                      "<path d='M " & _ax1 & " " & _ay0 & " L " & _ax2 & " " & _aym & " L " & _ax1 & " " & _ay1 & "' stroke='" & _arrowCol & "' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-linejoin='round'/>",
                      ""
                  ) &
                  "</svg>"
              )
          );

      ContentSwitcherItem(text:Text, w:Number, h:Number, active:Boolean, font:Text):Text = 
          "data:image/svg+xml;utf8," & EncodeUrl(
              With({
                  BgColor: If(active, AppTheme.ButtonPrimary, "#f4f4f4"),
                  TextColor: If(active, "#f4f4f4", "#8d8d8d"),
                  BorderColor: "transparent"
              },
              "<svg width='" & w & "' height='" & h & "' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'><rect width='100%' height='100%' fill='" & BgColor & "' stroke='" & BorderColor & "' stroke-width='1'/><text x='50%' y='50%' dominant-baseline='central' text-anchor='middle' fill='" & TextColor & "' font-family=""" & font & """ font-size='12px'>" & text & "</text></svg>"
          ));

      AppTheme = If(glbIsDarkMode, ThemeMap.Dark, ThemeMap.Light);
      CarbonFontFamily = "'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Arial";

      glbSideNavIconStr =
          If(!glbIsDarkMode, "rgba(198,198,198,1)", "rgba(82,82,82,1)");
      glbSideNavIconActiveStr =
          If(!glbIsDarkMode, "rgba(69,137,255,1)", "rgba(15,98,254,1)");

      Timeline_DayStart = DateAdd(DateValue(Text(glbSelectedDate, "yyyy-mm-dd")), 8 * 60, TimeUnit.Minutes);
      Timeline_DayEnd = DateAdd(DateValue(Text(glbSelectedDate, "yyyy-mm-dd")), 18 * 60, TimeUnit.Minutes);
      Timeline_SlotMinutes = 15;
      Timeline_SlotCount = 40;




      //------------------------------
      //--- Find Timeline Formulas ---
      //------------------------------

      varFindWindowStart = DateAdd(DateValue(Text(varFindSelectedDate,"yyyy-mm-dd")),8*60,TimeUnit.Minutes);
      varFindWindowEnd   = If(varFindViewMode="Day",DateAdd(DateValue(Text(varFindSelectedDate,"yyyy-mm-dd")),18*60,TimeUnit.Minutes),DateAdd(DateValue(Text(varFindSelectedDate,"yyyy-mm-dd")),7*24*60-360,TimeUnit.Minutes));
      varFindWeekStart   = DateAdd(varFindSelectedDate,-(Weekday(varFindSelectedDate,StartOfWeek.Monday)-1),TimeUnit.Days);
